samples.question: This picture is a 6 by 6 block of square rooms. Walls are solid ink, and you may walk between two rooms only through a doorway gap in the wall between them. Four rooms have a coloured floor: orange, green, blue and pink, and every one of the four stands on some round trip, so that on its own tells you nothing. A round trip is a walk that ends where it began and never passes through the same doorway twice. Exactly two of the four coloured rooms lie on one and the same round trip; for every other pair, no single round trip visits both. Which two rooms are they? Answer with exactly one of: orange+green, orange+blue, orange+pink, green+blue, green+pink, blue+pink.
